title: Quentin and the Veil
author: Hazel Dravenmoor
blurb: Ines Okafor, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
